items.observation: _startScale (and _startFocal, _startPosition, _startRotation) is written only at :460-463 and never returns to null. _inMotion reads `_startScale != null` and stays true after the first gesture. As a result the default filter stays at FilterQuality.medium on a zoomed, idle image, while the doc (:924-927) says 'high when the transform settles'. The filter tests (test/photo_view_test.dart:1041-1107) only write controller.scale and use no gesture; they miss the bug for that reason.
items.proposed_fix: At the end of _onScaleEnd (after the fields are read) and on the dismiss path, set the _start* fields back to null. Test: zoom with two fingers, pumpAndSettle, expect FilterQuality.high. Following the repository pattern, commit the red test first.
items.closure_criteria: The _start* fields return to null at the end of _onScaleEnd and on the dismiss path. A test that zooms with two fingers, pumps and settles and expects FilterQuality.high is committed red first.

items.kind: duplicate logic / many touch points per change (shotgun surgery)
items.observation: About 20 options are hand repeated in 11 places: 2 PhotoView constructors and two build calls; the ImageWrapper constructor, fields and forwarding; 2 PhotoViewCore constructors; 2 gallery constructors; 2 page-option constructors; two calls in the gallery. If a new option is skipped in one place it is silently lost.
items.proposed_fix: Define an unexported immutable options object in src. Let the PhotoView → ImageWrapper → PhotoViewCore chain carry this object; keep the public constructors unchanged. The existing 159 widget tests act as the safety net; also add a forwarding test that checks 'every option reaches the engine'.
items.closure_criteria: PhotoView, ImageWrapper, PhotoViewCore and the gallery carry one internal options object while the public constructors keep their signatures. A forwarding test checks that every option reaches the engine and the widget tests pass.

items.observation: dismissThreshold 0.2 is repeated six times. The black background is written in two different forms (_kDefaultDecoration and an inline BoxDecoration). The scale defaults are separate literals in four constructors.
items.proposed_fix: Define private constants in a single src file; let all constructors reference them. Behavior does not change.
items.closure_criteria: dismissThreshold, the background decoration and the scale defaults come from private constants in a single src file. The existing tests show no behavior change.

items.observation: The paragraph 'The sampling to use when the caller has not chosen one' describes the _wantedFilterQuality getter (:936) but is stuck to the doc of _syncFilterQuality (:929). The getter has no doc of its own.
items.proposed_fix: Move the paragraph to :936; keep a one-line doc on _syncFilterQuality.
items.closure_criteria: The sampling paragraph documents _wantedFilterQuality at its definition and _syncFilterQuality keeps a one-line doc.

items.observation: _kSettleDuration, unlike the other _k constants, has no doc. At :564 a 1e-6 sits as a bare epsilon.
items.proposed_fix: Add a one-line doc to _kSettleDuration; define a named _k constant for the epsilon.
items.closure_criteria: _kSettleDuration carries a one-line doc and the 1e-6 epsilon at line 564 is a named _k constant.

items.observation: _PhotoViewCoreState carries six responsibilities in about 780 lines: controller synchronization, animation, gestures, drag-to-dismiss, pointer signals, semantics/filter.
items.proposed_fix: Record it. When a section is touched, extract that section into a private helper class (dismiss first, then pointer signals); dismiss_test and pointer_signal_test act as the safety net. Until then do not grow the class.
items.closure_criteria: Drag-to-dismiss and pointer signal handling live in private helper classes extracted from _PhotoViewCoreState. dismiss_test and pointer_signal_test pass.

items.observation: The initial PhotoViewControllerValue is constructed twice with the same arguments.
items.proposed_fix: Write a private redirecting constructor that takes a single value. The value is immutable; sharing it in two places is safe.
items.closure_criteria: The initial PhotoViewControllerValue is constructed once through a private redirecting constructor.
